info.title: IELTSVega Mobile API
info.description:
The JSON API behind the IELTSVega mobile app.

**Envelope.** Every response is `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error }`. Branch on `ok`, and on `error.code` — not on the HTTP status, which is a coarser view of the same thing.

**Auth.** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, from any of the sign-in endpoints. Send `X-Client-Platform: ios|android` so sessions are scoped per platform — without it the app's session counts as a web one and will evict the candidate's browser session.

**Scores are never sent by the client.** Answers go up, bands come back.

tags.description: The practice library and submitting answers

post.summary: Create an account and sign in
Sign in with email and password
Sign in with a native Google id_token
post.description: Send the `idToken` from `google_sign_in` — NOT the access token. The token's audience must be one of the configured OAuth client ids.

get.summary: Validate the token and refresh the idle window
get.description: Call on cold start and on resume. Also returns anything that changed while the app was away — a plan bought on the website, a lapsed subscription. A 401 means: clear the keychain and show sign-in.

post.description: Always succeeds, even with no or an expired token. Only THIS session is revoked — the candidate's browser session survives.

get.summary: One full set — passage/recording plus its questions

post.summary: Grade a set and record the attempt
post.description: Writing and Speaking come back with `band: null`; poll `/api/v1/attempts/{attemptId}/score` when `subjective > 0`. A 402 carries `error.plan` — render the paywall from it.
`multipart/form-data`, field `audio`. MUST be 16 kHz mono PCM WAV — what Flutter's `record` package produces natively. Returns an audio location, never a band.

get.summary: One attempt in full, for review

get.description: `status` is one of `not_applicable`, `pending`, `scored`, `unavailable`. Poll while `pending`, waiting `retryAfterSec` between tries; give up at two minutes with whatever has arrived. `unavailable` will never resolve.

post.summary: Open a sitting, or resume one in progress
post.description: 201 = a new sitting. 200 with `resumed: true` = you already had one open.

get.summary: The sitting, as the player needs it
get.description: The clock is the SERVER's: render the countdown from `endsAt` and `remainingSeconds`, never from the device clock.

put.description: A draft, not a submission. Call every ~15s and after each answer: a phone gets backgrounded and killed, and this is the difference between resuming a paper and losing an hour of it. Idempotent.

post.summary: Hand in this module, open the next
post.description: `fromIndex` is a CLAIM and is checked against the server clock. Render what comes back; do not assume `fromIndex + 1`.

post.summary: Hand the whole paper in early

get.summary: The report for a handed-in paper
get.description: `pending > 0` means Writing/Speaking are still being marked. A null band with `pending === 0` means it could not be marked at all — say different things for those two.

`listPrice` is a FALLBACK. Show the store's own price from `ProductDetails`/`SKProduct`; store tiers vary by storefront. Gate buttons on `purchasable`, and hide them entirely when `alreadySubscribed`.

post.summary: Turn a store purchase into a subscription
post.description: Call after EVERY purchase and on restore-purchases. Do NOT finish/acknowledge the transaction with the store until this returns ok — an unacknowledged Play purchase is auto-refunded after three days. Idempotent.

token.description: Sent once and never readable again. Store in the platform keychain (flutter_secure_storage), not shared preferences.

message.description: Safe to show a user as-is.

fields.description: Per-field messages, keyed as the request body. Validation only.

plan.description: On `plan_required`: which tier, why, and how much allowance is spent.

Error.description: The failure half of the envelope.
